overview: The R1/R2 family now uses the Modern GAN training adaptation: paired relativistic logistic loss, native Adam, and squared critic input-gradient penalties on both real and fake samples. Its early schedule raises Adam's second-moment decay while reducing penalty strength. The retained older R1/R2 entry only swapped K3P's penalty and kept K3P's optimizer controls; it is a different complete recipe.
symbols: G: generator; D: critic; x: real batch; z: latent batch sampled from the task's prior; fake: generated batch; d: number of coordinates per critic input; g_r and g_f: critic input gradients on real and fake samples; D_bar: critic parameter exponential moving average; coefficient: penalty strength; cap: allowed input-gradient norm. mean averages samples, norm is Euclidean, relu(a)=max(a,0), softplus(a)=log(1+exp(a)), and detach stops gradients. The sketch is a scalar GAN loop; joint, conditional and reconstruction hosts supply their own inputs and auxiliary objectives. gamma is the scheduled R1/R2 coefficient; beta2 is Adam's second-moment decay. R1 is the real-sample squared input-gradient penalty and R2 is the fake-sample counterpart.
pseudocode: Apply the resolved LR schedule; cosine-interpolate beta2 and gamma over the first 20% of the task horizon.
Draw real x and prior z; fake = detach(G(z)).
g_r = gradient(D(x),x); g_f = gradient(D(fake),fake), using detached input copies.
Backpropagate L_D; take a native Adam critic step with no spike guard or global clipping.
Freeze D parameters; draw fresh z, regenerate fake and recompute both scores.
L_G = mean(softplus(D(x)-D(G(z)))); add only the host's declared auxiliary objective.
Backpropagate L_G; update G and any learned prior with native Adam.
Do not apply A2, critic anchoring, direct-particle gain or additive training noise.
Score the live model with the frozen task's sampling law.

training_details.loss: Paired relativistic logistic, the RpGAN component of the Modern GAN baseline. Forge uses the host's toy architecture and prior; this is not a reproduction of the paper's image architecture or full Stacked MNIST experiment.
training_details.optimizer: Modern canonical and selected cards use native torch.optim.Adam, beta1=0, epsilon=1e-8, AMSGrad off. Beta2 cosine-interpolates .9 to .99 over the first 20% of each resolved task horizon, then holds. Observer bookkeeping does not alter Adam's update.
training_details.learning_rates: Canonical modern card keeps .0002 constant for G/D and learned prior. The selected whole variant uses .0085, critic/prior multipliers 1, no short network horizon cap, and cosine LR decay from 20% of the resolved horizon to a 10% floor. Exact host binding determines the horizon.
training_details.gradient_clipping: Disabled in modern canonical/selected cards: d_guard_ratio=0 and no global gradient-norm clip. The squared input-gradient penalty changes the critic loss rather than clipping parameter gradients. The historical K3P swap retains its inherited spike guard.
training_details.critic_penalty: R1/R2 = gamma/2 times the mean squared L2 norm on real samples plus the corresponding fake term. Gamma cosine-interpolates 1 to .1 over the first 20% of the resolved horizon; it is applied each step. There is no cap threshold, RMS rescaling, LR-dependent handover or EMA proximity term.
training_details.damping_and_guards: Modern cards disable A2, direct-particle gain, critic spike guard and anchor. The older k3p-r1r2-matched-v1 keeps those K3P controls where its host supports them; they must not be attributed to the modern native-Adam baseline.
training_details.noise: Modern cards have zero additive critic-input and generated-output noise. A learned MoG may still have task-declared latent sampling noise; disabling training-output noise does not remove that prior law.
training_details.averaging: Modern cards set generator/prior EMA decay to zero and use live scoring. The paper's EMA image evaluation is not imported. Historical K3P penalty-swap receipts retain their own averaging configuration.

configuration_notes: Each result retains its executed source, recipe, task prior, initialization, budget and sampling law. These descriptions do not change or requalify recorded measurements.

Task-owned objectives and active components matter: direct sample particles, learned latent rows and a generator network are different parameter roles. A declared recipe switch does not imply that every host can apply it.

The selected r1r2--302b6baa44f629bfc97270c00a91f3cd6747585897bf43e105ab8aba2a276d6f was recorded at source 928b485ffbe6e17d79b41d307ae8b6275489b37a. Its .0085 rate and LR cosine differ from the canonical constant-.0002 card.

Toy component hosts retain their original direct-particle, conditional, joint or reconstruction objectives. A shorter host horizon scales the declared schedules through the explicit binding; an external execution cap does not silently redefine them.
The modern training adaptation, historical fixed R1/R2 swap and their recorded sources cannot pool successful cells or establish a single-change comparison.
